Maya R.: Quick handoff before I sign off — Velox Health VIP launch goes live tomorrow (Fri) at 14:00 UTC. I need Alex to cover the primary oncall until 16:00 UTC, then Samir will take over for the evening.

Maya R.: Key things to watch: prefix cache warming job runs at 13:30 UTC (it can spike CPU briefly), scheduled load test from partner at 15:00–15:30 UTC, and contract SLA requires p95 API latency < 350ms for the next 72h.

Maya R.: Runbook + checklist: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/velox-launch — see steps 1-4 under "VIP launch prep". If you don't have the internal access ping Priya.

Alex M.: Thanks — I'm online and will take first-line. Can you paste the quick health commands?

Maya R.: Sure — quick checks I run after deploy:
```
# check cluster pods / hpa
kubectl -n redwood get pods -l app=velox-api
kubectl -n redwood get hpa velox-api
\n# tail 5m error rate + latency
rcli metrics tail --service velox-api --window 5m --metrics "error_rate,p95_latency"
```

Maya R.: Alert thresholds I'm using: error_rate > 3% sustained for 5m -> escalate; p95 latency > 400ms sustained 10m -> investigate. Also autoscaler min replicas set to 6 for the VIP pool.

oncall-bot: Reminder: scheduled load test (Velox partner) at 2026-03-21T15:00:00Z — check capacity reservations.

Samir K.: Noted. Who has the reserved Dedicated pool for this customer? I thought we pinned them to dedicated-gpu-pool-3.

Maya R.: Yes, dedicated-gpu-pool-3. Autoscaling is enabled but burst capacity is limited to 8 GPUs for this pool. During the loadtest we might hit the cap — if we see queueing, enable the temporary burst in console (policy: velox-burst-override) or contact infra to raise cap.

Alex M.: How do I toggle the burst override quickly?

Maya R.: Console path: Console -> Capacity -> Pools -> dedicated-gpu-pool-3 -> Actions -> Enable Burst (select velox-burst-override). Or via CLI: `rcli capacity set-burst --pool dedicated-gpu-pool-3 --allow 12 --reason "velox loadtest"`

Priya D.: FYI I left a note on the contract slack: Velox SLA penalties kick in after 2 consecutive hours below 99.95% availability. Keep support aware if we see persistent degradation.

Jesse L.: For observability: dashboard link https://dashboards.redwood/velox/vip-overview — watch request queues and TokenUsage graph. I added a custom alert: queue_length > 200 for 3m -> #eng-oncall and #eng-sre.

Alex M.: Got it. I'll monitor from 13:00 UTC and be oncall for the launch window. If autoscaler can't keep up I'll run the burst override and post here.

Samir K.: I'll pick up at 16:00 UTC and stay until 23:00 UTC. If there's any sustained error_rate > 5% during partner loadtest escalate to eng-sre immediately.

Maya R.: One last note: the feature flags for Velox ramp are in LaunchDarkly under `velox.vip_ramp`. If you need to rollback traffic, flip to `control` and follow the rolloff steps in the runbook.

Alex M.: Copy. Adding a pinned checklist to the thread and will DM Priya if I need elevated permissions.

Priya D.: Permissions granted to Alex and Samir for the next 24h. Good luck, team :thumbsup: 

Jesse L.: If anyone needs me I'll be in #eng-sre. I'll keep an eye on infra alerts as a fallback.

Alex M.: Thanks all — will update here after the 13:30 warm-up and again post-launch.

Maya R.: Appreciate it — handing off now. Have a smooth launch :rocket:
